english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for saying that B remains true despite A.
Use this when the concession has an even-if or stronger hypothetical flavour rather than simply stating an existing fact.

examples.english: I will go jogging notwithstanding the heavy rain.
examples.traditional: 就算落大雨，我都會去跑步。
examples.jyutping: zau6 syun3 lok6 daai6 jyu5 ngo5 dou1 wui6 heoi3 paau2 bou6

examples.english: Despite having to queue for two hours, I’ll still wait for you.
examples.traditional: 就算要排兩個鐘，我都會等你。
examples.jyutping: zau6 syun3 jiu3 paai4 loeng5 go3 zung1 ngo5 dou1 wui5 dang2 nei5
